title: skills/docs: the ADR-0126 §1.3 promise pages and the skills teach what ADR-0146 D2 delivers — customizations in <base>.custom, `__c` fields, flow override and "new similar", no package-less overlay
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P3, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P3 "N-30 skills and docs — the §1.3 promise pages say what D2 delivers"; ADR-0126 §8 item 5. #28509 is this row's first slice. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28576, #28509, #28412, #28149, #28563, #28564, #28565

Part of #28236 (P3, child **N-30**) · governs: ADR-0146 D2 (what a customization is), D4, D10, D11; ADR-0126 §1.3 / §8 item 5 · lane: `domain:skills` (`skills/**`, Tier H; general content pages declared in item 1) · size: M.

**Business reason.** The docs promise an installed app can be customized, and describe the pre-epic paths. AI agents read the skills and write the old shapes: a package-less overlay, a field without `__c`, a clone that double-runs.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- §1.3 promise pages, both general content docs:
  - `content/docs/capabilities/integrations.mdx:18` and `content/docs/build-without-code.mdx:38`: views and dashboards are "yours to edit directly"; a packaged flow is switched off and cloned on Setup's packaged automation page; an object grows "via an extension package".
  - Under D2, D4, D9 and D10 all three are superseded: an override in `<base>.custom`, from Studio; the switch on the item; "new similar" or a declared flow override; `__c` extension fields in `.custom`.
- Other pages:
  - `deployment/install-modes.mdx:16` ("you customise beside it");
  - `data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx:22, :65, :95-104` (tenant field "not a package extension"; `fields` replaces a same-named field; prefix advice instead of `__c`);
  - `concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx:157` (the five-type overlay tier);
  - `permissions/permission-sets.mdx:364, :396-399` (clone as "your organization's own set", package-less);
  - `deployment/cli.mdx` (no `os migrate` row for the overlay ceremony);
  - `api/metadata-api.mdx` (the package-less write).
  Not read in detail: `automation/flows.mdx`, `plugins/packages.mdx`.
- Skills:
  - `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:376-381` (`defineObjectExtension`: no `__c`, no `.custom`, no patch);
  - `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md:142-170` ("Edit (overlay)" lock table);
  - `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:113` ("overlays").
  Not measured: `objectstack-automation`, `objectstack-studio-admin` (Setup's metadata admin moves to Studio, D1), `objectstack-ui`.
- #28509 covers the effective read on `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`, `references/system/metadata-persistence.mdx`, `references/api/package-api.mdx` and `ui/forms.mdx`. This card adds to those pages; it does not rewrite #28509's teaching.

**Wanted.**
1. **The §1.3 pages** say what D2 delivers. Every change to an installed package is an item of its `<base>.custom`, exported and deployed like any package and made in Studio. An override is a declaration; an object gains `__c` fields; a flow is overridden or copied with "new similar"; the switch is on the item. These two pages are general docs (`domain:devx` by the lane table) and stay in this card because ADR-0126 §8 item 5 asks for one correction; the PM may split them out as their own card.
2. **Skills teach the code path** for a `.custom` package:
   - `overrides: { package, basedOn }` only in the pair, with `basedOn` = the base's `manifest.version`, recorded and never judged;
   - a dependent renames;
   - the excluded types (permission set, position, capability) use "new similar" (N-20a);
   - `__c` extension fields and the display patch (N-23b, N-23d);
   - the flow override and its pinning (N-11) and "new similar" (N-21);
   - the `os migrate` ceremony for old package-less rows (#28413).
3. **The pages in Measured** are corrected; the package-less overlay is no longer taught as a customization path (N-16b refuses it).
4. Every taught rule cites the card or PR that landed it. ⛔ Nothing is taught before it lands (ADR-0126 §8 item 5: "not before").

**Tests.** `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations` and `check:docs-audit-scope` pass, and `pnpm docs:build` builds. A docs-accuracy pass (`scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs`) runs over the touched pages, and each taught sentence is checked against the landed code.

**Release safety.** Docs and skills only, landed after the behaviour they describe (`Blocked-by:`). A release right after it teaches only what that release does.

**Not here.** #28509 (the effective read). QA checklist and live e2e (N-29). ADR text (landed in #28295 / #28486).

**Dedupe.** #28509 (first slice). #26184 (open: audit skills against the protocol since 18.0, general, not this epic). Searched `customize in Studio docs` (44 hits, ADR and epic cards only) and `skills overlay is:open` (22 hits: #28509 and seat cards).
